metadata.description: Language-agnostic agentic development loop for Claude Code: research, plan, build, check, ship, with structural done, anti-shortcut hooks and an adversarial critic

plugins.name: blitz
plugins.description: Agentic development loop for any stack: research → plan → build → check → ship with per-task verify commands, structural done, fresh-context dev agents, an adversarial critic, anti-shortcut hooks, and next --loop for unattended runs. Deeper Vue/Nuxt/Firebase lanes when that stack is detected.

plugins.name: blitz-guard
plugins.description: Optional Claude Mod for blitz: blitz agents never become teammates or run on haiku, critics stay read-only by agent id, plan progress in the status line. An add-on to blitz's bash hooks.
